def convert_item_or_items_into_compiled_regexes_else_none(items):
    if items:
        if isinstance(items, strings):
            items = [re.compile(items)]
        else:
            # items is a list or iterable
            compiled_regexes = []
            for item in items:
                if isinstance(item, RE_COMPILED_TYPE):
                    compiled_regexes.append(item)
                else:

            items = compiled_regexes
